## About

Lunar Seismic FNO is the official implementation of *Fourier Neural Operator for Moonquake Detection* [@alqadasi2026moonquake]. It provides a 1D waveform model and a 2D spectrogram model, with reproducible training and evaluation workflows.

## Why it matters

Apollo seismic recordings are sparse and noisy, while the number of known lunar events is limited. Robust detection helps researchers recover more information about lunar seismicity and the Moon's interior from these irreplaceable records.

## Key result and audience

The project compares two complementary Fourier-neural-operator representations and keeps large datasets outside Git while documenting their exact public location. It serves planetary seismologists and researchers working on low-data event detection.
